name: Gift Cards On Demand For WooCommerce
author: PayThem

sections.description:
This plugin provides instant access to hundreds of popular gift cards on demand. Create WooCommerce products for selected gift cards and set customer pricing. After the customer pays, the plugin acquires the gift cards from PayThem. When the order is released, codes are delivered via your store to the customer.

The free version is fully functional for selling gift cards. Upgrading to Pro is optional.

Features (included)

  • No need to carry stock — purchase gift cards on demand after the customer pays
  • Access hundreds of gift cards at discounted reseller prices
  • Select which gift cards to sell and Import to Store or link individual products
  • Set fixed or percentage based prices for customers
  • Automatic price sync and optional Enforce Minimum Profit for fixed-price products
  • Optionally Buy & Carry local Stock with automatic replenishment
  • Control when a customer receives gift cards (release at Processing or Completed)
  • Choose whether to release codes in the regular WooCommerce order email
  • View and export Sales, Financial, Stock, and Reserved Stock reports
  • Low wallet / low profit email notifications

Optional Pro

Pro is a separate package and is not required. It adds:

  • Import Stock: Manually add voucher codes to local stock (Limited)
  • Bulk CSV Delivery (when order exceed the threshold set)
  • Delay purchases until order status is Completed
  • Limit Stock Visibility: Control how much stock customers can see on the front end

Read more about Pro

Demo Video

Demo Credentials

Get test/sandbox credentials here.

External services

This plugin connects to third-party services when configured:

  1. PayThem API (api.paythem.net / sandbox) — catalog sync, stock purchases, transaction history, and wallet checks. Credentials are stored in WordPress options and sent only to PayThem endpoints you configure (sandbox or production).
  2. Frankfurter — optional rate provider for converting PayThem costs into your store currency.
  3. Open Exchange Rates — optional rate provider; requires an App ID from openexchangerates.org.

Compatibility

This plugin has been tested with various themes and plugins.

Support

View the user guide documentation here.
Email support is available via our website PayThem.net

Requirements

TESTING: Get test/sandbox credentials here.

GO LIVE: Submit a Reseller Account Application here.

Privacy

The plugin does not share customer personal data with parties other than the external services you configure (see External services / FAQ). Reseller Accounts are subject to PayThem’s Privacy Policy: https://paythem.net/legal-terms/privacy-policy/

About Us

PayThem is an electronic voucher generation and gift card distribution software specialist, with offices in Australia, Canada, Qatar and UAE. PayThem’s electronic voucher distribution software provides a customizable and reliable solution for suppliers, distributors, retailers, resellers and consumers.
sections.installation:
Installation is quick and easy.

  1. Download, install and activate this plugin.
  2. Register as a PayThem Customer. Register here
  3. Submit a Reseller Application. Reseller Application
  4. Request Sandbox Credentials for TESTING.
  5. Request Production Credentials to go LIVE.
sections.faq:
Why is a Reseller Account required?

Merchants maintain a wallet balance on their secure Reseller Account. When an item is purchased, the cost price of the item is deducted from the Reseller wallet.

What about Multisite?

The plugin cannot be used on a multisite. Separate installations with separate credentials are required.

What about page speed?

The plugin has very little impact on front end load speeds.

Which external services does this plugin use?

  • PayThem — gift card catalog, availability, purchases, and wallet balance. You need PayThem reseller API credentials (username, password, public key, and private key). Terms of Use · Privacy Policy · Register
  • Frankfurter (optional automatic FX) — free ECB-based exchange rates; no API key. Used only when Automatic currency conversion is enabled with Frankfurter selected. Frankfurter
  • Open Exchange Rates (optional automatic FX) — free or paid App ID plans for FX rates when selected as the automatic provider. Terms · Privacy

Is upgrading to Pro required?

No. The free version is a fully functional gift card seller. Pro adds limited Stock Import, Bulk CSV Delivery & other benefits. Get Pro
sections.changelog:
4.0.2 – 2026-08-19

Enhancement – Persist PayThem-issued vouchers immediately, import every completed sale for a reference before buying, and skip PIN/serial duplicates so retries recover stock instead of repeating get_Vouchers.
Security – PayThem API requests use the WordPress HTTP API with SSL certificate verification enabled.

4.0.1 – 2026-08-12

Enhancement – Faster, safer fulfillment retry batch: single wait-marker lookup, 90-day order window, and a concurrency lock to prevent overlapping Action Scheduler runs from overloading MySQL (HPOS).

4.0.0 – 2026-07-13

New – Automatic exchange rates with Frankfurter (free, no API key) and Open Exchange Rates free/paid plans.
New – Rate Modifier (%) to adjust automatic PayThem-to-store conversion used for costs, pricing, and margins.
New – Import to Store: create draft WooCommerce products from PayThem denominations in one guided flow (replaces the old multi-step bulk import).
New – Optional Enforce Minimum Profit for fixed-price products so Regular price stays at or above your margin floor.
New – Automatic cleanup of discontinued PayThem catalog rows, with a daily admin digest email.
Enhancement – Reduced PayThem API usage via scheduled catalog and availability sync.
Enhancement – Mapped product prices recalculate automatically when PayThem cost, markup, or exchange rates change.
Enhancement – Clearer Buy local stock controls on the product edit screen, plus stronger recovery after failed purchases.
Security – Hardened admin settings, imports, and bulk actions with stricter capability and nonce checks.
Note – Pro-only (separate package): Import Stock (manual codes), CSV/B2B bulk delivery, Purchase Card = Completed, and Limit Stock Visibility.

3.5 – 2025-04-15

Enhancement – Compatibility with FraudLabs on HPOS
Enhancement – Local stock and front end selling price added to plugin product list
Enhancement – Cost price column added to WooCommerce product list
Enhancement – Improved bulk import user experience
Enhancement – Allow stocking more than API limits

3.4.2 – 2025-01-27

Tweak – Code update

3.4.1 – 2024-11-19

Enhancement – Internal cache improved for better speed

3.4 – 2024-11-06

Fix – Updated depreciated PHP functions
Enhancement – Improved inventory management

3.0.1 – 2024-07-30

Fix – Updated depreciated PHP functions

3.0 – 2024-03-06

Enhancement – Adapted FREE Version for WordPress.org listing
Enhancement – Adapted for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)

2.10 – 2022-05-23

Fix – Non-PayThem products in the store were being subjected to the plugin order limits.
Fix – The quantity selector in the product order edit page was sticky and has been fixed.
Security – Removed PIN code off WooCommerce thank you page.
Enhancement – Variable API purchase limits introduced
Enhancement – Sold stock will automatically be deleted from the database when order is trashed/deleted by admin.
Enhancement – Stock view now also includes the option to manually delete up to 250 sold items from the database.
Enhancement – Critical cron based tasks have been migrated from wp_cron to Scheduled Tasks.

2.9 – 2021-11-29

Fix – Bug fixes.
Enhancement – Improved front end price automation

2.8.1 – 2021-04-15

Enhancement – Improved usability by bolding PIN codes in outgoing order emails
Enhancement – Improved order deliverability by automatically scanning for failed orders
Enhancement – Improved Transaction Report exports

2.7 – 2020-07-03

Enhancement – Improved stock management
Enhancement – Added Reserved Stock Report

2.0 – 2019-12-18

Enhancement – Improved handling out of stock items.
Enhancement – Improved Order Notes.
Enhancement – Improved Transaction Reports.
Enhancement – Improved security Plugin settings visibility limited to Administrators.
Enhancement – Added ability to purchase stock on demand.
Enhancement – Added links to orders to display list of products attached to orders.

1.1 – 2019-09-17

Bug fixes.

1.0 – 2019-08-05

Initial Release.
